text:
Maya: Heads up — AtlasHealth asked for a half-day enablement next Tue 9am-1pm PT. They want 3 parallel tracks (data ingest, prompt tuning, infra). Renewal signal looks strong but this is a priority to de-risk.
Ravi: I can cover infra track. Happy to go over Dedicated migration + runbook.
Lena: I’ll own prompt tuning / hands-on lab (15min workshop + 30min lab). Need a VM image or quick setup guide.
Jordan: Can we run two simultaneous breakouts? One for architects (scaling/ops) and one for devs (prompts/SDKs).
Maya: Yes — plan to do breakout A = architects (infra + scaling) and B = devs (prompts + SDK). Need a facilitator for each.
Priya: I can facilitate the dev room but will need slides and a short checklist of common migration gotchas.
Sam: I’ll prep a 10min product roadmap + success metrics slide. Will share draft by Fri EOD.
Maya: We should collect pre-reads and a short pre-session survey to gather attendee roles and main pain points. Prefer forms.gle for simple capture.
Jordan: I’ll build the pre-read survey. 3 quick q’s: role, top 2 goals, biggest blocker. Will share link.
Ravi: Also we should surface infra prerequisites. Snippet of checklist:
```
- customer_account_id: confirm Dedicated pool id
- model_pin/version: decide final model variant
- VPC peering: confirm network & firewall rules
- sample payload: representative requests (seq len distribution)
- quotas: expected qps and burst policy
```
Lena: For the lab environment I’ll provide a small Docker image + instructions. Quick setup commands:
```
docker pull redwood/lab:latest
docker run -p 8080:8080 -e API_KEY=REPLACE redwood/lab:latest
# run example test prompt: curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"<your prompt>"}'
```
Maeva (AtlasHealth): Confirmed — Tue works for our superusers. Prefer hands-on examples around customer records ingestion and cost controls.
Maya: Good to know. I’ll ask CS lead to invite the 6 key reps. Also tagging renewal-risk-high internally so AMs prioritize follow-up.
Priya: One ask — can we record breakouts? Recording helps later enablement and AM notes.
RecordingBot: Recording scheduled for meeting ID 987654 (will upload to shared drive after session).
Maya: Logistics — proposing this calendar flow: 9:00–9:20 intro + roadmap, 9:20–10:10 breakout A/B round 1, 10:20–11:10 breakout round 2, 11:10–11:40 lab/demo, 11:40–12:00 wrap + next steps. Any objections?
Jordan: Looks good. Add a 10m buffer between breakouts for room swaps.
Sam: I’ll add the roadmap slide and one slide on committed SLAs for Dedicated customers.
Lena: Will attach the lab prep doc and a small troubleshooting FAQ by Mon.
Maya: I’ll open a Calendly slot page and share here. Also adding a quick 3-question pre-survey link when I post invites.
Maya: Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/atlas-enable-halfday — please review and comment on availability slots.
Jordan: Looks good for me. Marking as attending.
Ravi: Marked. I’ll also bring the infra runbook and a tiny demo of KV cache warm-up.
Priya: Confirmed. I’ll create a facilitator checklist (roles: timekeeper, Q triage, note taker) and drop it here.
Maya: Perfect — thanks team. If we can finalize speakers and assets by Fri we’ll get invites out to Atlas this week.
